notes: Inbound SMB lead from self-serve funnel. Use-case: call recording -> transcription -> agent summary + embeddings for search/rerank. They want low-latency summaries for agents (target <500ms for short prompts, bulk async for batch jobs). Main concerns: PII handling and retention — CTO asked whether we store raw transcripts/audio by default, retention windows, ability to auto-redact PII on ingest, and ability to purge on demand. Also asked for DPA sample and minimal SOC2/ISO artifacts; they are OK with hosted (public cloud) but need audit logging + SSO for admin console. Cost sensitivity: high — expecting heavy volume from ~200 agents, wants ballpark cost per minute and per-embedding. Quoted estimated ARR range $10k-$50k if pricing aligns and retention controls are satisfactory. Next steps: provide retention policy summary + DPA template + short checklist for security team; spin up trial org with token cap and sample redaction pipeline; follow-up call 2026-02-24. Notes from calls are in Fireflies links above. Representative quotes: "We cannot keep raw transcripts longer than 30 days by default"; "Need a simple way to redact credit card numbers and PII at ingestion".
